articles.title: NVIDIA CEO donates $10 million as Nepal faces $5 billion in rebuilding costs, finance minister says
articles.summary: The recent deadly flash floods in Nepal have damaged 12 hydropower projects, dealing a significant blow to the country’s energy infrastructure and other critical sectors, including banking and insurance. The destruction has left the government facing an estimated $5 billion rebuilding bill, the country's Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle said in an interview with CNN's Richard Quest. Nepal is receiving financial support from neighboring China and India, as well as institutions such as the World Bank and private donors, including NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, who donated $10 million.

articles.title: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia - Official Launch Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series, and PC. Check out the Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia launch trailer for this 2D platformer game to see its colorful world, gameplay, and more. In Marsupilami 2: Salsa Palombia, a strange melody has swept across Palombia… and all the animals have suddenly started dancing, leaving chaos in their wake! The creature behind this crazy beat is none other than the Mummy Queen, back from the Land of the Dead with her minions to play a cursed concert with a calamitous crescendo. Help Twister, Punch and Hope save Palombia from the Mummy Queen and her minions!
